units.current_bytes: bytes still allocated when the traced call returned (output / prepared structure kept alive)
units.peak_bytes: largest number of bytes allocated at any moment of the traced call

method: tracemalloc; fresh trace per method and phase; input built before tracing (not included); output kept alive; run separately from the timing script

included.input: NOT included (built before tracing). input_list_bytes_not_traced is sys.getsizeof(ids), the list's pointer array only, for reference
included.prepared_structure: included in prepare.current and in total.peak (sorted copy: list of n references; set: hash table)
included.output: included in query/total current and peak (list of q bool references)
